title: Turtle Armor Expanded
description: Adds into minecraft a full turtle armor set.
body:
Turtle Armor adds a new turtle armor - full turtle armor.

  The mod includes:
  - Turtle Helmet
  - Turtle Chestplate
  - Turtle Leggings
  - Turtle Boots

Also it include new crafts
- ![Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e42ecaf09bc150533556fadca21d9fbe0a020e5d_0.webp)

  It also updates the vanilla turtle helmet progression to better fit the full armor set.
